Desktop.dc.html.title: Grow light on a PC screen

n_main.text: Grow light card. Tap the door switch to try it: the plug goes off at once and comes back on when the door closes, but only inside the on hours. Unbuilt: nothing, this card is the built entity set.

n_setup.text: Add grow light setup step. Pick the plug, the start time, how many hours per day, and any door or window sensors. The same fields are in Options so they can be changed later.

n_desktop.text: PC screen: the same grow light with room to spread out. Status tiles, a 24-hour bar with the paused stretch in amber, a recent changes list, and the settings beside it. Below about 900 px the settings drop under the main column. Try the door button. Unbuilt: the Light today total and the recent changes list (they need history reading, not yet in the helper).
